meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.libelle: Évolution des tonnes vendues hors projet de mur frontalier vs T4 2025
guidances.citation: Excluding the impact of the border wall project, the Company estimates tons sold in the fourth quarter of 2026 will be up 4.0% to 6.0% compared to the fourth quarter of 2025, and, consistent with seasonal trends, down 5.5% to 7.5% compared to the third quarter of 2026.

guidances.libelle: Évolution des tonnes vendues y compris projet de mur frontalier vs T4 2025
guidances.citation: Including an estimated 9.5% year-over-year contribution from the U.S. border wall project, we anticipate tons sold will be up 13.5% to 15.5% compared to the fourth quarter of 2025.

guidances.libelle: Évolution du prix de vente moyen par tonne vendue vs T3 2026
guidances.citation: Reliance expects its average selling price per ton sold for the fourth quarter of 2026 will be up 1.0% to 3.0% compared to the third quarter of 2026.

Based on these assumptions, and inclusive of LIFO expense of $112.5 million, or $1.64 per diluted share, the Company anticipates non‑GAAP earnings per diluted share in the range of $7.40 to $7.60 for the fourth quarter of 2026, up over 200% year‑over‑year.
